title: Optimisation
description: The best of all choices is at the bottom of a valley: walk against the slope, a step at a time. Unlocks the Optimiser and the Optimised Pathway.

puzzle.goal: A ball sits on a bowl f = ½λx². Write where it is, X, after one move of size h against the slope, starting from x.
puzzle.name: Downhill update
puzzle.ask: Find X for x = @{x}, h = 0.1 and λ = @{λ}.
puzzle.method: The slope of ½λx² at x is λx; moving h against it subtracts hλx.
